# NIP-MP ingest fixtures

`NIP-MP.fixtures.json` is the unchanged, version 1, 31-case ingest fixture from
`projects/buzz/docs/nips/NIP-MP.fixtures.json`. Its SHA-256 is
`bda8cb81410c65511d4bce1c6f3d05e82337bb481c67b3398d3abc60bc8b1848`.

The protocol-compatibility crate owns this frozen test input so a fresh Made
checkout does not require the separately maintained, ignored Buzz source tree.
The original templates, case names, outcomes, and source provenance are preserved.
Templates are unsigned; tests sign them with their existing disposable test key.

The source tree declares Apache-2.0; its unchanged license is retained in
`LICENSE-APACHE`.
